Ram Temple Trust Faces Embezzlement Allegations Amidst Investigations

The Ram Temple Trust in Ayodhya is facing allegations of embezzlement concerning donation funds. Investigations are underway, with several individuals arrested and police raids conducted. The State Bank of India has reportedly sought the removal of staff involved in counting donations, while legal bodies have refused to represent the accused. The controversy has drawn political attention and calls for securing evidence.
